headlines.title: Growth in China’s factory-gate prices accelerates, but consumer inflation subdued
headlines.summary:
Growth in Chinese factory-gate prices continued to accelerate last month, while consumer price growth remained subdued despite Beijing’s efforts to shore up domestic demand and support the economy in meeting its annual growth target.
The producer price index (PPI) rose 5 per cent year on year in September, the highest rate since mid-2022, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday. It rose by 3.8 per cent in August.
The reading beat a projection of 4.3 per cent...
headlines.title_zh: 中国工业生产者出厂价格涨幅加快，但消费者通胀低迷
headlines.summary_zh:
中国出厂价格上月继续加速上涨，而尽管北京方面努力提振国内需求并支持经济实现年度增长目标，消费者价格涨幅仍保持低迷。
数据显示，9月份生产者价格指数（PPI）同比上涨5%，为2022年年中以来的最高水平。

headlines.title: 央行副行长陶玲：将继续支持金融机构开展人民币境外贷款和跨境贸易融资
headlines.summary: 【央行副行长陶玲：将继续支持金融机构开展人民币境外贷款和跨境贸易融资】中国人民银行副行长陶玲16日在全球财富管理论坛·2026上海苏河湾大会上表示，下一步，为了进一步满足离岸市场人民币流动性需求，我们将继续支持金融机构开展人民币境外贷款和跨境贸易融资，完善银行跨境同业人民币融资政策，鼓励更多境外机构参与熊猫债的发行和交易，支持香港发展人民币点心债市场。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Tao Ling: Will continue to support financial institutions in conducting RMB overseas lending and cross-border trade financing
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Deputy Governor Tao Ling: Will continue to support financial institutions in conducting RMB overseas loans and cross-border trade financing] Tao Ling, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, said on the 16th at the Global Wealth Management Forum·2026 Shanghai Suhewan Conference that next, in order to further meet offshore market demand for RMB liquidity, we will continue to support financial institutions in conducting RMB overseas loans and cross-border trade financing, improve policies for banks' cross-border interbank RMB financing, encourage more overseas institutions to participate in the issuance and trading of panda bonds, and support Hong Kong in developing the RMB dim sum bond market.

headlines.title_en: French Finance Minister: Optimistic about passage of the 2027 budget
headlines.summary_en: French Finance Minister Roland Lescure said that current financial market turmoil is prompting France's political factions to recognize the importance of fiscal prudence, and he is optimistic that parliament will ultimately pass the government's budget proposal. Lescure said: “The whole world is watching us. Apart from the crazies on the far left, everyone in parliament realizes that we must advance fiscal consolidation.” He acknowledged that high bond yields have helped him push all parties to face fiscal issues. France's National Assembly began reviewing the 2027 budget this week. However, the French parliament is deeply divided, and with only about six months left before the presidential election, reaching a compromise is difficult. headlines.title_en: French Finance Minister: Bond market turmoil forces parties to accept fiscal consolidation, optimistic about passage of the 2027 budget
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 16 — French Finance Minister Roland Lescure said that current financial market turmoil is prompting France's political factions to recognize the importance of fiscal prudence, and he is optimistic that parliament will ultimately pass the government's budget proposal. Lescure said: “The whole world is watching us. Apart from the crazies on the far left, everyone in parliament realizes that we must advance fiscal consolidation.” He acknowledged that high bond yields have helped him push all parties to face fiscal issues. France's National Assembly began reviewing the 2027 budget this week. However, the French parliament is deeply divided, and with only about six months left before the presidential election, reaching a compromise is difficult. If the budget cannot be passed, the government can still invoke Article 49.3 of the constitution to bypass a parliamentary vote, but it may then face a no-confidence vote and be forced to step down

headlines.title: 美联储主席沃什：在美国，我们现在把AI称为“SI”
headlines.summary: 美联储主席沃什：在美国，我们现在把AI称为“SI”。 人工智能（AI）对经济需求侧的影响将先于其供给侧冲击显现。 人工智能是我一生中最具深远影响的经济变革。 人工智能将有助于央行对数据及货币政策更有信心。 人工智能将改变实体经济，但对就业的短期影响仍存在不确定性。 人工智能将使经济效率更高、创造更多财富，但通往这一目标的道路将会充满波折。 美联储将于11月16日在旧金山湾区举行关于人工智能的现场听证会。

headlines.title_en: Fed Chairman Warsh: In the US, we now call AI "SI"
headlines.summary_en: Fed Chair Warsh: In the United States, we now call AI “SI.” The impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the demand side of the economy will appear before its supply-side shock. Artificial intelligence is the most far-reaching economic transformation of my lifetime. Artificial intelligence will help central banks be more confident about data and monetary policy. Artificial intelligence will transform the real economy, but the short-term impact on employment remains uncertain. Artificial intelligence will make the economy more efficient and create more wealth, but the path to that goal will be bumpy. The Federal Reserve will hold an in-person hearing on artificial intelligence on November 16 in the San Francisco Bay Area.
